title: STARTDT handshake followed by station interrogation
purpose: Exercise a valid IEC 60870-5-104 U-format session activation followed by an I-format station interrogation request, covering control-state transition and ASDU parsing.
expected_behavior: The peer accepts STARTDT activation and then parses the I-format ASDU as a General Interrogation activation with TypeID 100, one information object, activation cause, common address 1, information object address 0, and station interrogation qualifier 20.
constraints_preserved: U-format STARTDT activation and confirmation control values
I-format send and receive sequence fields are both zero
Length 0x0e covers four APCI control bytes plus the ten-byte interrogation ASDU
TypeID 100, activation cause, common address, information object address, and qualifier are kept in ASDU order
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed with no vulnerability assertion and no exact historical payload collision; values are ordinary protocol-valid session and interrogation fields.
